author: Cleo Abram
description:
This is a map of a secret network underneath your feet…

Just the top 15cm of Earth’s soil contains so much fungi, that if you stretched it out, it would extend all the way from here to the sun… 1 BILLION times. 

Scientists took soil samples to predict what fungi networks might look like. To find out what they discovered, subscribe! 

#shorts #fungi #maps #animation
title: There’s A Secret Network Under Your Feet
